scope: adapter and measurement calibration only; no generativity or ethical result

upstream.adaptation: independently authored binding fixture; A=1, B=2, ka=1, kd=1; network generation only; left/right and homodimer controls
upstream.upstream_original: A=100, B=100, ka=0.01, kd=1; ODE example
upstream.redistribution: upstream original retained only in ignored local provenance; no license inferred

sampling_gate: each category error <= 6*sqrt(p*(1-p)/N) + 1/N; diagnostic not a universal confidence guarantee

predictions.test: symmetric Q matches hand birth/death rates (2-n)^2, n
resolved Q matches two physical sites and projects onto symmetric Q
homodimer forward and reverse population rates equal 1
both samplers agree with computed endpoint distribution
passive relabeling and representational channel splitting preserve sampled-history entropy
resolved site-history entropy is strictly above occupancy-history entropy
predictions.criterion: positive difference at every preregistered cadence; sensitivity result not an invariance

retention: all compact evidence/source bundles retained; raw outputs local; no automatic deletion
